label: class_e_01_battle_01
text: Osu! Say hello to your battle instructor—\nThe one! The only! The hot-blooded Dendra!\c\n“Osu” is a karate thing, by the way. Look it up![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_02
text: My age? 25! My hobby? Working out!\nMy...type?! Well...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_03
text: Strong and muscular Fighting types, of course![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_04
text: That’s all for my introduction! As for my class,\nthis is where you all get to learn the nitty-gritty\r\nof Pokémon battling![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_05
text: We’ll start with the basics so that no Trainer gets\nleft in the dust! Even if you’re new to this stuff,\r\nhave no fear![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_06
text: Leave it to me and my muscles, and you’ll be\npros in no time.\c\nLet’s set our fighting spirits ablaze—together![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_07
text: Pokémon have all kinds of attack moves at their\ndisposal, and each move has certain qualities\r\nthat you’ll want to remember![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_08
text: I’m talking about the power, type, and [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]category[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nof these moves![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_09
text: Higher power means more damage—especially if\nyour opponent is weak to that move’s type![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_10
text: Heads up, new kid! Question coming your way!\c\nThere are two categories that attack moves can\nfall under. Know what they are?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_select_01
text: Moves of light and moves of darkness

label: class_e_01_select_02
text: Physical moves and special moves

label: class_e_01_select_03
text: Moves you love and moves you hate

label: class_e_01_battle_answer_01
text: That’s not only wrong—it’s totally out there!\c\nAre you OK, new kid?! Or are you just at that\nage where you’re really into fantasy stuff?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_answer_02
text: Awesome! You’re just as sharp as I expected, new\nkid! Looks like you have a handle on the basics![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_answer_03
text: That’s not only wrong—it’s kinda sad!\c\nAre you OK, new kid?! Or are you just at that\nage where you’re really into bittersweet stuff?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_11
text: Anyway, attack moves are split into two\ncategories—[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]physical[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]special[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_12
text: Physical moves do more damage the higher the\nPokémon’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Attack[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] stat is![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_13
text: And special moves do more damage the higher\nthe Pokémon’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sp. Atk[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] stat is![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_14
text: On the other side of things, Pokémon getting hit\nby these moves can take less damage by having\r\na high [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Defense[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sp. Def [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]stat, respectively![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_15
text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_16
text:
Pokémon that are good with [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]physical moves[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
should raise their [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Attack[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] stat!\c
And Pokémon that are good with [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]special moves[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
should raise their [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sp. Atk[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] stat![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_17
text: Trying to raise both of these stats equally will just\nmake it hard for the Pokémon to shine in battle![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_18
text: Make your strong points stronger, I always say—\nthat goes for both people and Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_19
text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we’re out of time...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_20
text:
We’ll generally meet for my class here in the
schoolyard—even for book learning!\c
Nothing like a little fresh air to make studying
more fun, am I right?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_01_battle_21
text: But class is over for now! Take care, you little\nrascals![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
